definition: Finding items whose vector embeddings are closest to a query, rather than matching exact keywords.
details: Text, images and other data are embedded into high-dimensional vectors, and approximate nearest-neighbor indexes retrieve the most similar ones at scale. It powers semantic search, recommendation and retrieval-augmented generation.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. And that is Vector Search — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
